Stock market news | Blackstone Sells 1.55% Stake in International Gemological Institute for ₹280 Crore

Blackstone completed the sale of a 1.55 percent stake in International Gemological Institute for ₹280.06 crore through block deals. The transaction involved selling over 67.16 lakh shares at an average price of ₹417 each.
